title: Hi, I'm $t(common:site.displayName)
description:
Thank you for visiting.
I hope you may become my teacher or friend.

For projects, experience, and how I work, please see my online resume.

This site is still under construction. Some content may be incomplete or incorrect. Thank you for understanding.

page01.title: Akashi
page01.maxim: Please tell me to stop scrolling

lines.building: This is still a small space under construction, thank you for visiting
lines.friend: I hope you may become my teacher or friend

page01.cta: How to tell me to stop scrolling

page02.title: Receptive Field
page02.subtitle: Sensing the world
description: I have some interest in what I study, though perhaps not too much.
A workstation should not be the edge of my view.
Sometimes I want to experience a richer and more complete world.

study.title: Study & Engineering
study.subtitle: My real-world coordinate system
bullets: Unfortunately, this part is still rather empty.
My advisor is very kind, so I should probably be able to graduate.
study.cta: This part is not that empty

world.title: World & Society
world.subtitle: Modeling the world and human society
bullets: How does society work? At least not exactly the way we were taught as children.
How does one make money? Work? Start a company? Move a mountain with a small lever?
How can I create the life I want?

beingHuman.title: Born, Then Becoming
beingHuman.subtitle: How a person can live
bullets: What kind of life do I want?
I want to understand and experience more varied ways of living.
I am curious about different professions and different cities, without being trapped by conventional ideas of good or bad.
I like living in different places for a while, though after entering university I have had almost no vacations.

expression.title: Expression & Feeling
expression.subtitle: Keeping the sensitive part of me
bullets: Visuals, photography, aesthetics, anime, and cute things.
I have been playing with PS, AE, C4D, and similar tools since middle and high school.
I like pink-blue gradients.

page03.title: Study
page03.subtitle: Will I graduate?
page03.bigline: There is not much here yet.

lines.engineering: Both of my parents are engineers. Compared with research, I am more drawn to building things.
lines.lowLevel: I like looking into lower-level systems.
lines.advisor: My advisor is very kind, so I should probably be able to graduate.

page04.title: Slacking off again
page04.subtitle: Hopefully you have already reminded me to stop looking at my phone

fitness.title: Fitness
bullets: My coach is asking me to train again.
I have found that Codex and treadmill climbing are surprisingly compatible.

swimming.title: Swimming
bullets: It makes my neck feel much better.
A 6100 lung capacity lets me swim for quite a while.

archery.title: Archery
bullets: If I skip practice again, I will feel a little guilty toward the team captain.
Every time I pause for a while, I have to readjust my form and find the feeling again.

overwatch.title: Overwatch
bullets: I once used Kiriko to shut down every Sigma ultimate from the other team in a ranked match.
I do not argue back when people flame me.

worldOfWarships.title: World of Warships
bullets: Sea monkey, meaning not especially skilled.
When people flame me, I reply with "thank you".

photography.title: Photography
bullets: My old point-and-shoot and mirrorless cameras both broke.
I am using an impulsively bought film camera now, and I still have not finished the first roll.

travel.title: Travel
bullets: Recently I really want to go places: Chongqing, Japan, and New Zealand.
Since the end of Gaokao, I have wanted to go to Japan to play Kantai Collection Arcade, but the game is basically gone and I still have not made it to Japan.

flight.title: Flight
bullets: One day, when I have time, I must learn to fly a plane.

page04.aside: I am very lucky to have friends who keep playing alongside me.

page05.title: Still searching
page05.subtitle: I do not want to project negativity, but I really am quite lost right now.

lines.ai: With the shock of AI, finding work feels very difficult.
lines.future: I am not sure what kind of future I want, so I do not yet have a clear goal to pursue.
lines.world: I want to widen my view and see broader worlds and more varied ways to live.
lines.balance: I want to understand how people actually practice work-life balance.

page05.endline: Recently I have wanted more coffee chats, and to meet more specific, concrete people.

page06.title: Friends
page06.subtitle: Thank you for being here along the way.

pending.title: List in progress
pending.description: This will become a careful place for people, projects, and kindness I truly want to recommend.

exchange.title: Link exchange
exchange.description: If you would like to be here too, come say hello first.
